enemies.name: reed-shambler
enemies.flavor: A borrowed coat of reeds, still walking.

enemies.name: mire-lark
enemies.flavor: Sings sweetly. Means nothing good by it.

enemies.name: drowned tollman
enemies.flavor: Keeps counting a toll no one pays anymore.

enemies.name: echo-wisp
enemies.flavor: The last word of a prayer nobody finished.

enemies.name: sanctified husk
enemies.flavor: Knelt so long the kneeling became bone.

enemies.name: Bell-Warden
enemies.flavor: Still guarding a door that rotted before the flood.

enemies.name: ash-revenant
enemies.flavor: The ash, in the shape of someone missed.

enemies.name: cinder-hound
enemies.flavor: It tracks warmth. Yours will do.

enemies.name: hollow deacon
enemies.flavor: Leads a congregation of one: itself.

enemies.name: THE GRAVECHO
enemies.flavor: The great bell's dead twin. It remembers being sung to.
